# Licensing scope

This folder is a frozen copy of Continuity v0.3.0-preview.10.2, kept unmodified in IronTrellis for differential testing. Its [NOTICE](NOTICE) refers to this file and to [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md); in Continuity both sat at the repository root, not in this folder, so IronTrellis adds them here.

What applies to this folder: the Continuity-authored code, tests and documentation in it are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)), Copyright 2026 Continuity contributors. Nothing in it is relicensed.

## The original file

Continuity's repository-level LICENSING.md, unchanged (sha256 610957af9f061f288d74431950567f07752ddc6fc80b7249b728039c34b54d1b). Its links point into the Continuity repository, not into this folder.
